text: I rode south of Fairbanks on the Richardson Highway and the shoulder was wide enough for a loaded bike in dry weather.
I stayed at a city campground on the edge of Whitehorse and filled drinking water from a tap by the tent area.
I waited about forty minutes at Port Alcan and was asked for passports only. The duty phone was +1 907 555 0199.
I found a grocery in Tok for resupply and there is enough ordinary food there for several days on the Alaska Highway. Write rider.demo@example.com if you want them to hold a box.
Update: the grocery in Tok is closed now and resupply there is not possible for a loaded bike.
Is the campground in Watson Lake open this week or is it closed for the rest of the season?
I rode past Destruction Bay and bears were close to the road, so I kept bear spray on the bike the whole afternoon.
